title: heuchera parviflora var. rugelii
intro: Heuchera parviflora var. rugelii, commonly known as Coral Bells, is a type of flowering plant in the saxifrage family native to North America. Research suggests that the plant has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Heuchera parviflora var. rugelii include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, as well as its possible use in treating certain skin conditions. However, the exact bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects have not been extensively studied, but it is known to contain compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
